title: Site builds
subtitle: Build a saved version, inspect the result, then choose where to publish.
savedOnly: Only saved documents in the selected language are included. Unsaved editor changes stay in your draft.
availabilityUnconfigured: Set up a document build executor to create sites. Your administrator can use the Docker Compose configuration.
availabilityUnavailable: The build executor is unavailable. Check the connection or try again.
availabilityIncompatible: The executor protocol or engine version is incompatible.
retrying: Connection interrupted. Checking the existing job again; this will not create another build.
previewNotice: Static preview: choose a page above the frame. Scripts, external resources and page links are disabled. Download the ZIP for the complete website.
selectBuild: Select a build to inspect its output and saved revisions.
artifactExpired: Generated output has expired. Source revisions and build metadata are preserved. Create a new build when needed.
retentionNotice: Up to 50 generated outputs are kept for 14 days within a shared 512 MB limit. Builds do not publish a website.
deleteConfirm: Remove this build record and its generated output? Source documents will remain available.
invalidInput: Check the site settings. Use an HTTP(S) origin without a path, and a base path such as / or /docs/.
unavailable: Site builds are temporarily unavailable. Try again.
notFound: Build or document space not found.
crossOrigin: This build request must come from PandaForce.
busy: Other builds are being prepared. Wait for one to finish and try again.
historyFull: Build history is full. Remove old build records before creating another.
idempotencyConflict: This request ID already belongs to different build settings. Refresh the build list.
executorUnconfigured: A build executor has not been configured.
executorUnavailable: The build executor could not be reached. Existing jobs will be checked again.
executorMissing: The executor no longer has this job. Create a new build to try again.
executorConflict: The executor rejected this build identity. Create a new build.
executorProtocol: The executor returned an incompatible or invalid response.
requestExpired: This queued request expired before execution. Create a new build when ready.
snapshotUnavailable: The saved build snapshot could not be read. Create a new build.
artifactUnavailable: The generated output is unavailable or has expired.
buildActive: Cancel the active build before removing its record.
emptyDocuments: There are no saved documents in this content language.
snapshotTooLarge: The document snapshot exceeds build limits. Reduce the number or size of documents and images.
assetUnavailable: A referenced image is unavailable or belongs to another document.
unsupportedImageReference: An image reference cannot be exported safely. Insert it as a Markdown image and use a supported filename.
executorRestarted: The executor restarted during this build. Its output was not published; create a new build to retry.
buildFailed: The engine could not build this site. Check the build log for details.
buildTimeout: The build exceeded its time limit.
imageUnavailable: The configured build image is not available. Ask your administrator to check the image and pull policy.
imagePullFailed: The configured image could not be downloaded. Check registry access.
incompatibleImage: The configured image does not support this build protocol or engine.
inputDigestMismatch: The input content did not match its saved digest.
artifactDigestMismatch: The generated output failed its integrity check.
outputTooLarge: The generated website exceeds the output size limit.
executorStorageFull: The executor has reached its storage limit.
registryCredentialsUnavailable: The image registry credentials are unavailable to the executor.
registryHelperUnsupported: The executor cannot use a host credential helper. Configure scoped registry credentials.
previewTooLarge: This page is too large for the isolated preview. Download the site ZIP to inspect it locally.
unsupportedDocumentPath: The built-in themes currently require unique .md document paths without special path characters. Check the source paths before building.
unsupportedSnapshot: A saved document contains content that this build preset cannot accept. Check its content, size and site settings.
themeExecutorRequired: Update the companion executor to support versioned site themes.
themeWorkerRequired: The configured worker image does not support site themes. Ask your administrator to update its image.
unknownTheme: The selected theme version is unavailable.
incompatibleTheme: This theme is incompatible with the selected engine.
spaceSettingsChanged: The space settings changed. Refresh the build workspace and review the current theme before building again.
trustedThemeExecutorRequired: Update the companion executor to support approved executable theme packages.
trustedThemeWorkerRequired: The configured worker image does not support executable theme packages.
themeNotApproved: This theme version is disabled, unavailable or no longer approved. Select an enabled approved version before building.
sourceProjectExecutorRequired: Update the companion executor to support source project profiles and theme dependencies.
sourceProjectWorkerRequired: The configured worker image does not support source project profiles. Ask your administrator to update it.
themeDependencyUnavailable: A theme dependency is missing or its version differs from the approved package. Update the administrator-selected worker image.
sourceThemeRequired: Source WebP mode requires an approved source theme. Package, review and select the original theme before building.
sourceImageRuleMissing: An image is outside the selected site resource rules. Update Source settings.
sourceImageCompanionMissing: A revision is missing its original image or matching WebP companion. Check the source images and refresh the source.
sourceResourceConflict: Selected documents bind different image versions to the same output path. Reconcile these versions before building.
placementSourceUnavailable: A linked original is unavailable or in the trash. Restore it or remove its publication link before building.
placementPathConflict: Two documents use the same destination path. Update the publication links or document paths.
placementLocaleMismatch: A linked original has changed language. Update its publication link or select a revision in this language.
sourceEditionMissing: This language edition is no longer available. Update the publication link or source settings.
invalidPlacementMetadata: A publication link contains metadata that the current space policy does not accept. Review the link settings.
invalidPlacementTarget: A publication link no longer has a valid destination. Review the link settings.
unsupportedSourceSyntax: This source engine needs a format adapter before it can be built with the selected engine. Use its original engine or a project document.
profileThemeExecutorRequired: Update the companion executor to support configurable site theme packages.
profileThemeWorkerRequired: The configured worker image does not support configurable site theme packages. Ask your administrator to update it.
inputBusy: Build input processing is busy. Retrying shortly.
storageFull: Build input storage or history capacity is full. Remove unused builds and retry.
resourceBuildExecutorRequired: The configured executor does not support native theme resources. Ask the administrator to update it.
configuredTheme: Use the theme configured for this document space.
themeChoiceHint: Choose an enabled version for this build. You can build a public sample before applying it. Existing documents and space settings remain as saved.
hexoStylusWorkerRequired: The configured build service or worker image cannot compile this theme’s Stylus styles. Ask the administrator to update the document build images.
